DFT_4([1,2,3,4])=[10,-2+2j,-2,-2-2j]; duplicating it into both output halves is correct for zero odd-index samples and is not a symmetry premise.

M(N)=2M(N/2)+N/2 and A(N)=2A(N/2)+N with zero base cases solve to (N/2)log2N twiddle slots and Nlog2N additions for N a power of two.

The total inverse scale 1/N and running X[0]=10 versus X[0]/8=1.25 are correct. Independent calculation gives scale error 0.875 and permutation error 0.7907245477594312. The first formula leaves epsilon undefined until lines 424-429.
Direction/sign, total scale, coefficient order, length/range, and numerical error rule are sufficient declared interface clauses; N=1 and wrong-multiset-address boundary cases are handled correctly.
